name: 盛岡城跡公園
what: 南部氏の居城だった盛岡城の跡で、花崗岩の高い石垣が残る国史跡の公園。
whatEn: The site of Morioka Castle, seat of the Nanbu clan, a national historic site park with tall granite stone walls.
notice: 本丸北面の石垣のあたりは、通行が制限されています。
noticeEn: Access is restricted near the north stone wall of the main enclosure.

name: 岩手県立美術館
what: 萬鉄五郎・松本竣介・舟越保武ら岩手ゆかりの作家を中心に集める県立美術館。
whatEn: Iwate's prefectural art museum, centred on artists linked to the region such as Yorozu Tetsugoro, Matsumoto Shunsuke and Funakoshi Yasutake.

name: もりおか啄木・賢治青春館
what: 明治43年築の旧第九十銀行本店（国重要文化財）を使い、啄木と賢治の盛岡時代を伝える館。
whatEn: A museum on the Morioka youth of Ishikawa Takuboku and Miyazawa Kenji, in the 1910 former Ninetieth Bank head office, an Important Cultural Property.

name: 岩手銀行赤レンガ館
nameEn: The Bank of Iwate Red Brick Building
what: 辰野金吾らが設計した明治44年完成の旧盛岡銀行本店で、国の重要文化財。
whatEn: The former Morioka Bank head office, completed in 1911 to a design by Tatsuno Kingo's firm, a national Important Cultural Property.
